generic.Defined scope/population: All active salary grades in the current compensation structure

Done when every active grade has a complete base salary array exported.
verify: Check the exported row count against the HRIS active headcount by grade.

steps.title: Load the survey benchmark data into the BI reporting platform
sop: Open the market pricing workbook in the BI/reporting platform.
Import the current survey benchmark cut for each matched grade.
Confirm the benchmark years and aging basis match the current cycle.
Done when survey benchmarks are loaded for every benchmark-eligible grade.
verify: Compare the loaded benchmark count to the survey participation list.
Pass when every benchmark-eligible grade has a loaded benchmark value.

Compute the 25th, 50th, and 75th percentile values.
Enter the results into the salary structure workbook's percentile columns.
Done when percentiles are calculated for every active grade.
verify: Spot-check two grades' percentile math against the raw salary array.
Pass when the spot-checked percentiles match the workbook formula output.

steps.title: Compute the market ratio for each grade
sop: Divide each grade's average actual pay by its market 50th percentile.
Record the resulting market ratio in the workbook's ratio column.
Round the ratio to two decimal places per the workbook standard.

Pass when the recalculated ratio matches the recorded value.

steps.title: Flag grades outside the 80%-120% target range

Pass when no flagged grade is left without a disposition.
